text:
incident-bot: PAGED: auth.failure.rate spike in prod (5xx/401 mix) from edge clusters - spike started ~3333311200. dashboard: https://rwd.in/ops/dash/XYzA1

pagerbot: Pager alert -> oncall: OnCall-Mike (priority: high) :rotating_light:

OnCall-Mike: I'm on call. Starting triage now. Pulling up traces and logs.

sara-sec: noted. I'm seeing concentrated requests from a small IP set (3 ranges). UA strings look randomized. Could be credential stuffing or a misconfigured forwarder.

linh-eng: I have tail logs from edge-1/edge-3. Sampling shows lots of 401s against /v1/generate with the same svc-account id in headers but different sigs. Collecting full request headers.

OnCall-Mike: initial impact: ~2.1% of requests across EU region return 401. Two paying customers have increased error reports: AcmeCorp and Belltower. No evidence of data exfil yet.

gina-cs: I'm on standby with support. AcmeCorp reported errors in ingestion around 08:12 UTC. I'll gather their request ids if we confirm.

sara-sec: quick snippets from log (sanitized):
```
[08:12:34] edge-3 10.4.5.12 GET /v1/generate 401 svc-account:ingest-runner UA: "curl/7.85.0" sig:Xk1...
[08:12:35] edge-3 10.4.5.12 GET /v1/generate 401 svc-account:ingest-runner UA: "python-requests/2.28" sig:Ab9...
```

sara-sec: hypothesis: a service token for ingest-runner may have leaked or been replayed. Recommend rotating that token ASAP and blocking offending IPs at edge.

infra-ops: FCFS — we can rotate the service token but need a short maintenance window for the ingest pipeline. Are there any live jobs that would break immediately?

linh-eng: we can issue a staged rotation: create new token, update a small percentage of runners, validate, then swap. I'll start the new token creation and update plan.

OnCall-Mike: Plan (short):
1) block the 3 offender IP ranges at WAF (temporary).
2) create new svc token for ingest-runner and start a canary rollout to 5% of runners.
3) enable stricter UA/rate heuristics on edge for 30m.
4) collect affected request ids and notify customers impacted.

sara-sec: I'll implement WAF block now and add a signature rule for the randomized UA pattern. Pushing block to edge-1/2/3.

infra-ops: WAF blocks applied to the listed ranges. Confirmed propagation to CDN within ~60s.

linh-eng: new token created: token-id: tok_new_9a2f (rotating), initiating 5% rollout to ingest-runner pool. Monitoring auth success rate.

OnCall-Mike: monitoring: auth 401 rate dropped from 2.1% -> 0.6% in EU after WAF + canary. Good signal.

gina-cs: drafting incident message for AcmeCorp + Belltower. Asking for sample request ids to correlate. Will hold on sending until we confirm full rotation. :pencil2:

sara-sec: Forensics: no signs of PII in logs forwarded to sec. We redacted headers already in the sample. We'll keep scanning for suspicious egress.

legal-bot: Legal notified. No customer data leak suspected at this time per initial scan. Please preserve logs and chain of custody for 72h.

OnCall-Mike: Next actions: finish 100% token swap (in 15m if canary OK), lift temporary WAF block after 60m of no reappearance, and prepare postmortem with timeline and mitigations.

linh-eng: canary looks stable. Proceeding with full swap now. Rolling updates to all ingest-runner services.

infra-ops: Rotation completed. Old token revoked: tok_old_3b7e. Confirmed no auth failures linked to rotated token after 5m.

OnCall-Mike: Verified customer-facing error rates back to baseline. Marking active mitigation complete. Triggering incident create for follow-up: owner=sara-sec, timeline logging in ops/incidents/3333311222.

gina-cs: sending initial customer note to affected tenants now (short note + status). Will schedule follow-up comms with timeline once postmortem is ready.

sara-sec: I'll start a focused postmortem, include suggested hardening: shorter service token TTLs, audit of token issuance, and add anomaly detection for randomized UA + repeated sig failures.

OnCall-Mike: thanks team. Leaving for handoff in 30m to next oncall. If anything reappears, re-page pagerbot. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Incident acknowledged closed by OnCall-Mike at 3333311305.
